description: Pin CoinGecko coins into every run's State. Connect with a CoinGecko Pro API key and a ticker list.
limitations: Quotes USD price and 24h change at run start. Not a trading venue and not CoinGecko's on-demand tools.
setup_hint: Connect with a CoinGecko Pro API key, then search coins to pin.

state.intro: `prices` lists the coins the operator pinned for this agent with their CoinGecko USD price fetched at run start: `usd`, `change_24h_pct`, and `updated_at` (ISO-8601, CoinGecko's last update). Use those values as reference prices without a tool call. An entry with `unavailable` has no price this run; the value says why.

coins.title: Pinned coins
coins.description: Their USD price enters State at every run start for agents using this login.
